why: A method is given its own object (doc 'Method Invocation'), and concatenating objects of one class gives that class (doc 'Concatenating Objects'): `k = [k, obj]` and `k = [obj(1), k]` in methods of `@Gizmo` keep `k` a Gizmo, so `tidy(k)` is `Gizmo::tidy` (step 15 round 7: a concatenation with the variable itself among its elements keeps its class).
